summary: ansible.netcommon deprecated the parse_cli, parse_cli_textfsm and parse_xml filters (removal after 2027-02-01) in favor of ansible.utils.cli_parse with the matching parser.
questions: How do I parse TextFSM output without parse_cli_textfsm?

answer_card.title: netcommon parse filters deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated in ansible.netcommon, removal after **2027-02-01** (warnings now shown when used):

- `parse_cli` → `ansible.utils.cli_parse`
- `parse_cli_textfsm` → `ansible.utils.cli_parse` with the `ansible.utils.textfsm_parser` parser
- `parse_xml` → `ansible.utils.cli_parse` with the `ansible.utils.xml_parser` parser
